## Register

Registers a new user account and returns a bearer token upon successful registration.

---

### Endpoint

**POST** `{{url}}/api/register`

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `fullName` | string | Yes | Full name of the user |
| `email` | string | Yes | Email address of the user |
| `password` | string | Yes | Password for the account (minimum 8 characters) |

**Example:**
```json
{
  "fullName": "Mustafa",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "12345678"
}
```

---

### Response

#### 200 OK — Success

Returns the newly created user object along with a bearer authentication token.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `status` | boolean | Indicates whether the request was successful |
| `message` | string | Human-readable result message |
| `data.user.id` | integer | Unique ID of the registered user |
| `data.user.fullName` | string | Full name of the registered user |
| `data.user.email` | string | Email address of the registered user |
| `data.user.createdAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when the user was created |
| `data.user.updatedAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when the user was last updated |
| `data.token.type` | string | Token type (e.g. `bearer`) |
| `data.token.token` | string | The authentication token to use in subsequent requests |
| `data.token.abilities` | array | List of token permissions |
| `data.token.expiresAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Token expiry timestamp |

**Example:**
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "fullName": "Mustafa",
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "createdAt": "2026-07-09T12:41:18.959-04:00",
      "updatedAt": "2026-07-09T12:41:18.959-04:00",
      "id": 71
    },
    "token": {
      "type": "bearer",
      "name": null,
      "token": "oat_MzU...",
      "abilities": ["*"],
      "lastUsedAt": null,
      "expiresAt": "2026-08-08T16:41:19.050Z"
    }
  }
}
```

## Login

Authenticates a user with their credentials and returns a bearer token for use in subsequent authenticated requests.

---

### Endpoint

**POST** `{{url}}/api/login`

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON object with the following parameters:

| Parameter  | Type   | Required | Description                        |
|------------|--------|----------|------------------------------------|
| `email`    | string | ✅ Yes   | The registered email of the user.  |
| `password` | string | ✅ Yes   | The account password of the user.  |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "email": "admin@experts.com",
  "password": "Abc@1234"
}
```

---

### Response

**200 OK** — Login successful.

The response contains a bearer token and the authenticated user's details.

| Field                          | Type    | Description                                              |
|-------------------------------|---------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `status`                      | boolean | `true` if the request was successful.                    |
| `message`                     | string  | Human-readable status message.                           |
| `data.token.type`             | string  | Token type — always `"bearer"`.                          |
| `data.token.token`            | string  | The bearer token to use in the `Authorization` header.   |
| `data.token.abilities`        | array   | Scopes/permissions granted to the token (e.g., `["*"]`). |
| `data.token.expiresAt`        | string  | ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the token expires.    |
| `data.user.id`                | integer | Unique identifier of the authenticated user.             |
| `data.user.fullName`          | string  | Full name of the authenticated user.                     |
| `data.user.email`             | string  | Email address of the authenticated user.                 |
| `data.user.type`              | integer | User type/role identifier.                               |
| `data.user.isActive`          | boolean | Whether the user account is active.                      |
| `data.user.hasCompletedOnboarding` | boolean | Whether the user has completed onboarding.          |

**Example Response:**

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Logged In Successfully",
  "data": {
    "token": {
      "type": "bearer",
      "name": null,
      "token": "<token_value>",
      "abilities": ["*"],
      "lastUsedAt": null,
      "expiresAt": "2026-08-08T16:41:32.377Z"
    },
    "user": {
      "id": 1,
      "fullName": "Super Admin",
      "email": "admin@experts.com",
      "type": 1,
      "isActive": true,
      "createdAt": "2026-04-01T13:25:38.000-04:00",
      "updatedAt": "2026-04-17T06:18:31.000-04:00",
      "hasCompletedOnboarding": false,
      "pqId": null
    }
  }
}
```

---

### 🔐 Token Auto-Save

A post-response script is configured on this request. After a successful login, the bearer token is **automatically extracted and saved** to the environment variable `token`. This allows subsequent requests to reference the token via `{{token}}` in their `Authorization` header without any manual steps.

## Impersonate Login

This endpoint allows a privileged system or admin user to authenticate on behalf of another user (impersonation). It is useful for administrative workflows where a system account needs to act as a specific user without knowing that user's credentials.

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON payload with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string | The email address of the **acting user** (the system/admin account performing the impersonation). |
| `password` | string | The password of the **acting user**. |
| `target_user_email` | string | The email address of the **user to be impersonated**. |

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "email": "system@experts.com",
  "password": "Abc@1234",
  "target_user_email": "admin@experts.com"
}

 ```

---

### Response

On success, the response returns a `200 OK` with a bearer token and the details of the impersonated user.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `data.token.type` | Token type — always `"bearer"`. |
| `data.token.token` | The bearer token to use for subsequent authenticated requests. |
| `data.token.abilities` | Scopes/permissions granted to the token. |
| `data.token.expiresAt` | ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the token expires. |
| `data.user` | Object containing the impersonated user's profile (`id`, `fullName`, `email`, `type`, `isActive`). |

**Example response:**

``` json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Impersonation successful",
  "data": {
    "token": {
      "type": "bearer",
      "token": "<oat token>",
      "abilities": ["*"],
      "expiresAt": "2026-08-08T16:41:40.063Z"
    },
    "user": {
      "id": 1,
      "fullName": "Super Admin",
      "email": "admin@experts.com",
      "type": 1,
      "isActive": true
    }
  }
}

 ```

---

### Automatic Token Storage

After a successful response, the post-response script automatically extracts the bearer token from the response body and saves it to the **`token`** **environment variable**. This means subsequent requests that reference `{{token}}` will immediately use the impersonated session's token without any manual copy-paste.

## Me

Fetches the profile of the currently authenticated user.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires a valid Bearer token. Include the token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: {{token}}
```

If the token is missing, invalid, or expired, the request will return a `401 Unauthorized` response.

---

### Request

**Method:** `GET`  
**URL:** `{{url}}/api/me`

No request body is required.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns the authenticated user's profile data.

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "User fetched successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "fullName": "Super Admin",
    "email": "admin@experts.com",
    "type": 1,
    "isActive": true,
    "createdAt": "2026-04-01T13:25:38.000-04:00",
    "updatedAt": "2026-04-17T06:18:31.000-04:00",
    "hasCompletedOnboarding": false,
    "pqId": null
  }
}
```

#### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | boolean | Indicates whether the request was successful |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status message |
| `data.id` | integer | Unique identifier of the user |
| `data.fullName` | string | Full name of the user |
| `data.email` | string | Email address of the user |
| `data.type` | integer | User type/role identifier |
| `data.isActive` | boolean | Whether the user account is active |
| `data.createdAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when the account was created |
| `data.updatedAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp of the last account update |
| `data.hasCompletedOnboarding` | boolean | Whether the user has completed the onboarding flow |
| `data.pqId` | string / null | Associated PQ identifier, or `null` if not set |

---

### Error Response — `401 Unauthorized`

Returned when the provided token is invalid or has expired.

```json
{
  "status": false,
  "message": "Unauthorized"
}
```

---

### Variables

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `{{url}}` | Base URL of the API server |
| `{{token}}` | Bearer token for authenticating the request |

## Logout

Logs out the currently authenticated user by invalidating their session or token.

---

### Request

**Method:** `GET`  
**URL:** `{{url}}/api/logout`

#### Variables

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | Base URL of the API server |
| `token` | Authentication token for the current session |

---

### Response

#### Success (200 OK)

``` json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Logged out successfully",
  "data": {}
}

 ```

#### Unauthorized (401)

Returned when the token is invalid or has already expired.

---

### Examples

- **me** — Successful logout with a valid token. Returns `200 OK`.
    
- **invalid/expiry token** — Request made with an invalid or expired token. Returns `401 Unauthorized`.

## Show Note

Retrieves a specific note by its unique identifier, along with its full associated data including chat history, child notes, webhook versions, practitioner and patient information, AI scoring details, review statuses, and workflow state.

---

### Endpoint

`GET {{url}}/api/notes/:note_id`

---

### Path Variable

| Variable | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `note_id` | The unique UUID of the note to retrieve | `bd513491-c71a-40fb-a504-f0b0f420d99d` |

---

### Authentication

This request uses the `token` variable for authentication. Ensure the `token` environment variable is set with a valid bearer or session token before sending the request.

---

### Response Structure

A successful `200 OK` response returns a note object containing the following key fields:

**Note Metadata**
- `id`, `noteId`, `sessionId`, `sessionTime`, `type`, `priority`
- `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
- `parentNoteId`, `is_current_note`, `previous_note`, `child_note`
- `version_count`, `chat_count`

**Practitioner & Patient Info**
- `practitionerId`, `practitioner` — includes `fullName` and `email`
- `patientId`, `patient` — includes `clientId`

**AI Scoring & Review**
- `aiScore`, `aiStatus` — AI-generated scoring and processing status
- `humanReview`, `humanReviews`, `noteReviewMarks` — human review records and marks
- `reviewCycle`, `reviewers`, `manager`
- `feedback_verdicts`, `diagnosis`

**Workflow & Billing**
- `workflow` — current workflow state of the note
- `cptCodeId` — associated CPT billing code

**Related Data**
- `chats` — array of chat entries, each containing `prompt`, `evaluationScore`, `bedrockResponse`, and `mcp_response`
- `childNotes` — array of child notes linked to this note
- `webhookVersions` — webhook version history associated with the note
- `session` — session details linked to the note

# Note JSON File API

## Overview

This endpoint returns a test dataset used for validating clinical note documentation quality. It provides sample session data along with scoring output to evaluate the accuracy and completeness of clinical notes.

## Request

| Property | Details |
| --- | --- |
| **Method** | `GET` |
| **URL** | `{{url}}/api/notes/test` |
| **Auth** | Uses `{{token}}` variable for authentication |
| **Request Body** | None |

---

## Response

### `200 OK`

Returns a JSON object containing a status message and an array of test data items.

``` json
{
  "status": "...",
  "message": "...",
  "data": [ ... ]
}

 ```

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `string` | Indicates the result of the request (e.g., `"success"`) |
| `message` | `string` | A human-readable message describing the response |
| `data` | `array` | Array of test note evaluation objects |

---

### `data[]` — Test Note Item

Each item in the `data` array represents a clinical note evaluation entry with the following structure:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `instruction` | `string` | A clinical documentation instruction string describing what the note should capture |
| `CURRENT_SESSION` | `object` | Details of the current clinical session being evaluated |
| `PREVIOUS_SESSION` | `object` | Details of the previous clinical session for comparison |
| `output` | `object` | Evaluation result containing score, pass/fail status, and identified issues |

---

### `CURRENT_SESSION` / `PREVIOUS_SESSION`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `note_id` | `string` | Unique identifier for the session note |
| `session_date` | `string` | Date of the clinical session |
| `session_details` | `string/object` | Detailed content or notes from the session |

---

### `output`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `score` | `number` | Quality score for the note, ranging from `0` to `100` |
| `pass` | `boolean` | Whether the note meets the passing threshold (`true` / `false`) |
| `issues` | `array` | List of identified issues with the note |

### `output.issues[]`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `issues_related_to` | `string` | The category or aspect of the note the issue relates to |
| `issue_description` | `string` | A detailed description of the identified issue |
| `issue_type` | `string` | Classification of the issue type (e.g., missing info, inaccuracy) |

---

## Notes

- This endpoint is intended for **testing and validation purposes**.
    
- The `{{url}}` and `{{token}}` values should be configured in your active Postman environment before sending the request.

## Mark Note Review

Marks or unmarks a note review mark for a specific reviewer. This endpoint updates the review marking status of a note for a given reviewer and note version.

**Method:** `PATCH`  
**URL:** `{{url}}/api/note-review-marks/mark`

---

### Request Body

The request body should be sent as JSON with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `note_id` | `string` | The UUID of the note to be marked (e.g. `"a082989b-55e6-4f7d-92dd-82277bc39e3f"`) |
| `reviewer_id` | `string` | The ID of the reviewer performing the mark action (e.g. `"29"`) |
| `marked` | `boolean` | Whether the note should be marked (`true`) or unmarked (`false`) |
| `note_version_id` | `string` | The version ID of the note being reviewed (e.g. `"505"`) |

---

### Example Request Body

```json
{
  "note_id": "a082989b-55e6-4f7d-92dd-82277bc39e3f",
  "reviewer_id": "29",
  "marked": true,
  "note_version_id": "505"
}
```

## Queue Statistics

Retrieves queue statistics for notes within a specified date range. This endpoint provides a breakdown of note statuses across the processing pipeline, including AI review outcomes and human review queues.

---

### Endpoint

`GET {{url}}/api/notes/queue-statistics`

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start_date` | string | ✅ Yes | The start date of the statistics range (YYYY-MM-DD). | `2024-01-01` |
| `end_date` | string | ✅ Yes | The end date of the statistics range (YYYY-MM-DD). | `2025-12-11` |

---

### Response

**Status:** **`200 OK`**

``` json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Queue statistics retrieved successfully",
  "data": {
    "total_notes": 0,
    "ai_passed": 0,
    "ai_failed": 0,
    "pending_human_review": 0,
    "pending_manager_review": 0,
    "blacklist": 0
  }
}

 ```

#### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | boolean | Indicates whether the request was successful. |
| `message` | string | A human-readable message describing the result. |
| `data.total_notes` | integer | Total number of notes within the specified date range. |
| `data.ai_passed` | integer | Number of notes that successfully passed the AI review stage. |
| `data.ai_failed` | integer | Number of notes that failed the AI review stage. |
| `data.pending_human_review` | integer | Number of notes currently awaiting human review. |
| `data.pending_manager_review` | integer | Number of notes currently awaiting manager review. |
| `data.blacklist` | integer | Number of notes that have been flagged and added to the blacklist. |

## Workload Statistics

Retrieves aggregate workload statistics for the clinical note review pipeline. This endpoint provides key performance metrics that help supervisors and managers monitor reviewer efficiency, AI model alignment, and overall note processing health.

### Authentication

Requires a valid Bearer token passed via the `Authorization` header using the `{{token}}` variable.

### Request

**Method:** GET  
**URL:** `{{url}}/api/notes/workload-statistics`

No query parameters or request body are required.

### Response

Returns a JSON object with the following structure:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | boolean | Indicates whether the request was successful. |
| `message` | string | A human-readable status message. |
| `data.assign_notes` | integer | Number of notes currently assigned to reviewers. |
| `data.avg_review_time` | float | Average time (in minutes or hours) taken to review a note. |
| `data.return_rate` | integer | Percentage of notes returned for revision or correction. |
| `data.ai_disagreement_rate` | integer | Percentage of notes where the human reviewer disagreed with the AI assessment. |

### Example Response

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Workload statistics retrieved successfully",
  "data": {
    "assign_notes": 0,
    "avg_review_time": 2.97,
    "return_rate": 15,
    "ai_disagreement_rate": 30
  }
}
```

### Notes

- `ai_disagreement_rate` can be used to track model accuracy and flag cases where AI scoring may need recalibration.
- `return_rate` reflects the proportion of notes sent back to practitioners for corrections.
- `avg_review_time` is a useful metric for identifying reviewer bottlenecks.

# Update Note

## Overview

Updates an existing note record identified by its UUID. This endpoint allows partial updates to a note's metadata, including the associated practitioner, patient, note type, AI status, human review status, manager assignment, workflow state, and priority level.

---

## HTTP Method & URL

```
PATCH {{url}}/api/notes/:note_id
```

---

## Path Variables

| Variable  | Type   | Description                              |
|-----------|--------|------------------------------------------|
| `note_id` | UUID   | The unique identifier of the note to update. Example: `94b77b6b-c9bb-4a62-8e72-2bdeae6ee56b` |

---

## Request Body

**Content-Type:** `application/json`

| Field              | Type    | Description                                                  |
|--------------------|---------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| `practitioner_id`  | integer | The ID of the practitioner associated with the note.         |
| `patient_id`       | integer | The ID of the patient associated with the note.              |
| `type`             | string  | The note type ID (e.g., `"1"` for `progress_note`).         |
| `ai_status`        | string  | The AI status ID (e.g., `"1"` for `passed`).                |
| `human_review`     | string  | The human review status ID (e.g., `"1"` for `not_needed`).  |
| `manager`          | string  | The manager status ID (e.g., `"1"` for `not_needed`).       |
| `workflow`         | string  | The workflow status ID (e.g., `"1"` for `completed`).       |
| `priority`         | string  | The priority level ID (e.g., `"1"` for `low`).              |

**Example Request Body:**

```json
{
  "practitioner_id": 1,
  "patient_id": 3,
  "type": "1",
  "ai_status": "1",
  "human_review": "1",
  "manager": "1",
  "workflow": "1",
  "priority": "1"
}
```

---

## Response Structure

### Success Response — `200 OK`

| Field     | Type    | Description                                      |
|-----------|---------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `status`  | boolean | `true` if the update was successful.             |
| `message` | string  | A human-readable confirmation message.           |

| `patientId`     | integer         | ID of the associated patient.                                               |

## List Notes

Retrieves a paginated list of clinical notes with optional filtering and sorting.

**Base URL:** `{{url}}/api/notes/listing`

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | Page number (1-based) |
| `pageSize` | integer | Number of records per page |
| `filters` | array | List of filter objects (see below) |
| `sorts` | array | List of sort objects (see below) |

#### Filter Object

Each filter object supports the following structure:

```json
{
  "columnName": "<field>",
  "type": "exact" | "like",
  "value": <value>
}
```

**Available filter columns:**

| `columnName` | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `not_reviewed` | boolean | Filter notes that have not been reviewed |
| `not_reviewed_by_user_id` | integer (exact) | Filter by user ID who has not reviewed |
| `search` | string (like) | Full-text search across notes |
| `id` | integer (exact) | Filter by internal note ID |
| `note_id` | string (like) | Filter by note UUID |
| `session_id` | string (exact) | Filter by session identifier |
| `practitioner_id` | integer (exact) | Filter by practitioner ID |
| `patient_id` | integer (exact) | Filter by patient ID |
| `type` | integer (exact) | Filter by note type ID |
| `ai_score` | integer (exact) | Filter by AI evaluation score |
| `ai_status` | integer (exact) | Filter by AI status ID |
| `human_review` | integer (exact) | Filter by human review status ID |
| `manager` | integer (exact) | Filter by manager status ID |
| `workflow` | integer (exact) | Filter by workflow status ID |

---

### Response

**Success (200)**

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Notes listed successfully",
```

## Session Webhook

This endpoint receives session/appointment note data via webhook and queues it for asynchronous processing.

**Method:** `POST`  
**URL:** `{{url}}/api/webhook/session`

---

## Authentication

Requires a Bearer token passed in the `Authorization` header. The token is sourced from the `{{token}}` environment variable.

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```

---

## Request Body

The request body must be a JSON object containing the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `AppointmentId` | string | The ID of the appointment. |
| `NoteId` | string | The UUID of the note. |
| `ClientId` | string | The client's ID. |
| `Date` | string (ISO 8601) | The date of the session. |
| `Diagnosis` | array | List of diagnoses associated with the session. Can be empty. |
| `EventDate` | object | Firestore-style timestamp with `nanoseconds` and `seconds` fields. |
| `EventTimestamp` | object | Firestore-style timestamp with `nanoseconds` and `seconds` fields. |
| `LastModified` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp of when the note was last modified. |
| `NoteName` | string | Name of the note (e.g., `"Progress Note"`). |
| `PractitionerEmail` | string | Email address of the practitioner. |
| `PractitionerId` | string | ID of the practitioner. |
| `PractitionerName` | string | Full name of the practitioner. |
| `Questions` | array of objects | List of note questions and answers. Each object contains: `id`, `text`, `answer`, `question_type`, and `office_use`. |
| `Status` | string | Current status of the note (e.g., `"locked"`). |

### `Questions` Object Structure

Each item in the `Questions` array has the following shape:

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "text": "string",
  "answer": "string",
  "question_type": "string",
  "office_use": true
}
```

---

## Success Response

**HTTP Status:** `200 OK`

Returns a JSON object confirming the webhook was received and the job was queued:

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Job queued for processing",
  "jobId": "string"
}
```

---

## Post-Response Behavior

After a successful response, the token extracted from the response is automatically stored into the `token` environment variable for use in subsequent requests.

## Overview

This endpoint retrieves a paginated list of practitioners. It supports optional filtering and sorting to help narrow down or order the results as needed.

**Method:** `POST`
**URL:** `{{url}}/api/practitioners/listing`

---

## Request Body

The request body should be sent as JSON with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | integer | ✅ Yes | The page number to retrieve. Starts at `1`. |
| `pageSize` | integer | ✅ Yes | Number of results to return per page. e.g. `10`. |
| `filters` | array | ❌ No | An array of filter objects to narrow results. |
| `sorts` | array | ❌ No | An array of sort objects to order results. |

### `filters` Object

Each item in the `filters` array should have the following structure:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `columnName` | string | The field to filter on (e.g. `id`, `email`, `type`). |
| `type` | string | The filter type (e.g. `exact`). |
| `value` | any | The value to match against the specified column. |

### `sorts` Object

Each item in the `sorts` array should have the following structure:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `columnName` | string | The field to sort by (e.g. `id`). |
| `orderBy` | string | Sort direction — `asc` for ascending or `desc` for descending. |

### Example Request Body

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "pageSize": 10,
  "filters": [
    {
      "columnName": "type",
      "type": "exact",
      "value": "doctor"
    }
  ],
  "sorts": [
    {
      "columnName": "id",
      "orderBy": "asc"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## Response

### 200 OK

A successful response returns the following structure:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `status` | boolean | Indicates whether the request was successful. |
| `message` | string | A human-readable status message. |
| `data.count` | integer | Number of records returned in the current page. |
| `data.total_count` | integer | Total number of practitioners across all pages. |
| `data.total_page_count` | integer | Total number of pages available. |
| `data.page` | integer | The current page number. |
| `data.page_size` | integer | The number of results per page. |
| `data.data` | array | List of practitioner objects. |

### Practitioner Object (`data.data[]`)

Each practitioner in the `data.data` array contains:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | any | Unique identifier of the practitioner. |
| `fullName` | string | Full name of the practitioner. |
| `email` | string | Email address of the practitioner. |
| `type` | string | Type/role of the practitioner. |
| `isActive` | boolean | Whether the practitioner account is active. |
| `createdAt` | string | Timestamp when the record was created. |
| `updatedAt` | string | Timestamp when the record was last updated. |
| `hasCompletedOnboarding` | boolean | Whether the practitioner has completed onboarding. |
| `pqId` | any | Associated PQ identifier. |

### Example Response

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Practitioners retrieved successfully.",
  "data": {
    "count": 10,
    "total_count": 85,
    "total_page_count": 9,
    "page": 1,

}
```

## Authentication

This request requires a Bearer token for authentication. The token is stored in the `{{token}}` environment variable.

Make sure the `token` variable is set in your active environment before sending this request. The `Authorization` header should be configured as:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```

---

## Show Manager Review

Retrieves a specific manager review by its unique ID. This endpoint returns full details of a manager review record, including decision metadata, AI/manual scoring, priority, nested related objects, and SME issues.

---

### Method & URL

```
GET {{url}}/api/manager-reviews/:id
```

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Description                                      |
|-----------|---------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `id`      | integer | Yes      | The unique identifier of the manager review. Example: `1` |

---

### Authentication & Variables

| Variable  | Description                                                                 |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `{{url}}` | Base URL of the API server (set in the active Postman environment)          |
| `{{token}}` | Bearer token used for authentication — include in the `Authorization` header |

---

### Response Structure

**Status: `200 OK`**

Returns a manager review object with the following key fields:

#### Review Metadata

| Field          | Type    | Description                                      |
|----------------|---------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `id`           | integer | Unique ID of the manager review                  |
| `managerId`    | integer | ID of the manager associated with the review     |
| `reviewId`     | integer | ID of the linked review                          |
| `noteId`       | integer | ID of the associated note                        |
| `versionId`    | integer | ID of the note version                           |
| `versionLabel` | string  | Human-readable label for the version             |

#### Decision & Scoring

| Field            | Type    | Description                                                        |
|------------------|---------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `decision`       | string  | Decision outcome, e.g. `"approve_note_valid_and_compliant"`        |
| `aiScore`        | integer | Score assigned by AI (e.g. `100`)                                  |
| `manualScore`    | integer / null | Score assigned manually; `null` if not yet set              |
| `aiStatus`       | string  | AI evaluation result, e.g. `"passed"`                              |
| `humanResult`    | string  | Result from human review                                           |
| `humanDecision`  | string  | Final human decision on the review                                 |
| `human_review_score` | integer | Score from human review (e.g. `80`)                          |

#### Additional Fields

| Field                    | Type    | Description                                              |
|--------------------------|---------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `priority`               | string  | Priority level of the review, e.g. `"low"`               |
| `disagreement`           | boolean | Whether there is a disagreement between AI and human     |
| `comment`                | string  | Optional comment on the review                           |
| `chat_count`             | integer | Number of chat messages associated with the review       |
| `practitionerNotifiedAt` | string  | ISO 8601 timestamp when the practitioner was notified    |
| `createdAt`              | string  | ISO 8601 timestamp of record creation                    |
| `updatedAt`              | string  | ISO 8601 timestamp of last update                        |

#### Nested Objects

| Field          | Description                                      |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `manager`      | Details of the manager who performed the review  |
| `review`       | The linked review object                         |
| `practitioner` | The practitioner whose note was reviewed         |
| `version`      | The specific note version that was reviewed      |
| `reviewer`     | The reviewer assigned to this record             |
| `session`      | Session context associated with the review       |

#### SME Issues (`smeIssues`)

An array of SME (Subject Matter Expert) issue objects, each containing:

| Field              | Type   | Description                                  |
|--------------------|--------|----------------------------------------------|
| `errorType`        | string | Category/type of the identified error        |
| `issuesRelatedTo`  | string | Area or topic the issue is related to        |
| `issueDescription` | string | Detailed description of the issue            |

## Overview

This endpoint retrieves a paginated list of manager reviews. It supports optional filtering and sorting to narrow down or order the results. Use this endpoint to query manager review records with flexible criteria such as manager ID, decision status, AI status, priority, and more.

**Method:** `POST`
**URL:** `{{url}}/api/manager-reviews/listing`

---

## Request Body Parameters

The request body must be sent as JSON.

| Parameter   | Type    | Required | Description                                                                 |
|-------------|---------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `page`      | integer | Yes      | The page number to retrieve (1-based index).                                |
| `page_size` | integer | Yes      | The number of records to return per page.                                   |
| `filters`   | array   | No       | An array of filter objects to narrow down results. See filter fields below. |
| `sorts`     | array   | No       | An array of sort objects to order results. See sort fields below.           |

### Filter Object Fields

Each object in the `filters` array can contain the following fields:

| Field        | Type   | Description                                                                                   |
|--------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `columnName` | string | The name of the column to filter on. See **Available Filter Columns** below.                  |
| `type`       | string | The filter type (e.g., `"exact"`, `"date_range"`).                                            |
| `value`      | any    | The value to filter by. Used for `exact` type filters.                                        |
| `startDate`  | string | Start of a date range in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Used with `date_range` type filters.            |
| `endDate`    | string | End of a date range in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Used with `date_range` type filters.              |

### Sort Object Fields

Each object in the `sorts` array can contain the following fields:

| Field        | Type   | Description                                              |
|--------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `columnName` | string | The name of the column to sort by.                       |
| `orderBy`    | string | Sort direction: `"asc"` for ascending, `"desc"` for descending. |

---

## Available Filter Columns

|--------------------|--------------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `manager_id`       | exact        | integer    | Filter by the ID of the manager.                                            |
| `review_id`        | exact        | integer    | Filter by the ID of the review.                                             |
| `note_id`          | exact        | string     | Filter by the note ID associated with the review.                           |
| `practitioner_id`  | exact        | integer    | Filter by the ID of the practitioner.                                       |
| `decision`         | exact        | integer    | Filter by the decision value on the review.                                 |
| `ai_status`        | exact        | integer    | Filter by the AI processing status of the review.                           |
| `priority`         | exact        | integer    | Filter by the priority level of the review.                                 |
| `human_result`     | exact        | integer    | Filter by the human result/outcome of the review.                           |
| `created_at`       | date_range   | string     | Filter by creation date range. Use `startDate` and `endDate` in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. |
| `search`           | exact        | string     | Full-text search across review records.                                     |

---

## Available Sort Columns

| Column Name  | Supported `orderBy` Values | Description                        |
|--------------|----------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `id`         | `asc`, `desc`              | Sort by the review record ID.      |
| `created_at` | `asc`, `desc`              | Sort by the creation date/time.    |

---

## Example Request Body

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "page_size": 10,
  "filters": [
    {
      "columnName": "ai_status",
      "type": "exact",
      "value": 1
    },
    {
      "columnName": "created_at",
      "type": "date_range",
      "startDate": "2024-01-01",
      "endDate": "2024-12-31"
    }
  ],
  "sorts": [
    {
      "columnName": "created_at",
      "orderBy": "desc"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## Response

### 200 OK — Success

Returns a paginated list of manager review objects.

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Manager reviews retrieved successfully.",
  "data": {
    "count": 10,
    "total_count": 150,
    "total_page_count": 15,
    "page": 1,
    "page_size": 10,
    "data": [ /* array of manager review objects */ ],
    "human_review_score": 85.5
  }
}
```

### Response Fields

|--------------------------|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|

| `message`                | string  | Human-readable message describing the result.                               |

---

### Method & URL

```
DELETE {{url}}/api/manager-reviews/:id
```

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Description                                      | Example |
|-----------|---------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|---------|
| `id`      | integer | ✅ Yes   | The unique identifier of the manager review to delete. | `1`     |

---

### Authentication

This endpoint requires **Bearer Token** authentication. Include the token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: {{token}}
```

> The `{{token}}` variable should be set in your active environment before sending the request.

---

### Request Body

No request body is required for this endpoint.

---

### Response

#### ✅ 200 OK — Success

Returned when the manager review is successfully deleted.

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Manager review deleted successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 1
  }
}
```

| Field            | Type    | Description                                          |
|------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `status`         | boolean | `true` indicates the operation was successful.       |
| `message`        | string  | A human-readable confirmation message.               |
| `data.id`        | integer | The ID of the manager review that was deleted.       |

## Update Manager Review

Updates an existing manager review record by its unique ID. This endpoint allows managers to submit or revise their evaluation of a practitioner's note, including scores, decisions, comments, and AI-related metadata.

---

### Method & URL

`PATCH {{url}}/api/manager-reviews/:id`

---

### Authentication

This endpoint requires a Bearer token. Set the `{{token}}` variable in your environment to authenticate requests.

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```

---

### Path Variable

| Variable | Type    | Description                              | Example |
|----------|---------|------------------------------------------|---------|
| `id`     | integer | The unique ID of the manager review to update | `1` |

---

### Request Body

Send a raw JSON body with the following fields:

| Field              | Type         | Description                                                                 |
|--------------------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `review_id`        | integer      | The ID of the review being updated                                          |
| `note_id`          | string (UUID)| The UUID of the associated note                                             |
| `chat_id`          | integer      | The ID of the associated chat session                                       |
| `decision`         | integer      | The manager's decision (e.g., `1` = approved)                              |
| `practitioner_id`  | integer      | The ID of the practitioner being reviewed                                   |

| `ai_score`         | integer      | Score assigned by the AI system                                             |
| `disagreement`     | integer      | Disagreement level between the manual and AI scores                         |
| `comment`          | string       | Manager's comment or notes regarding the review                             |
| `ai_status`        | integer      | Status of the AI evaluation                                                 |

```json
  "status": false,
  "message": "Something went wrong",
  "errors": [
    {
      "message": "Manager review not found"
```

## Create Error Type

Creates a new error type in the system. Error types define categories of errors with associated point values, used for scoring and evaluation purposes.

---

### Endpoint

**POST** `{{url}}/api/error-types`

---

### Request Body

Send a raw JSON object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Yes | Internal identifier name for the error type (e.g. `"critical pro"`). Used programmatically to reference the error type. |
| `display_name` | string | Yes | Human-readable label shown in the UI, typically including point deduction info (e.g. `"Critical (-25 pts)"`). |
| `points` | integer | Yes | Point value associated with the error type (e.g. `30`). |

**Example Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "critical pro",
  "display_name": "Critical (-25 pts)",
  "points": 30
}
```

---

### Successful Response (200 OK)

Returns a confirmation message along with the newly created error type object.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | boolean | `true` if the error type was created successfully. |
| `message` | string | A human-readable success message. |
| `data.id` | integer | Auto-generated unique identifier for the new error type. |
| `data.name` | string | Internal name of the error type. |
| `data.displayName` | string | Human-readable display label. |
| `data.points` | integer | Point value associated with the error type. |
| `data.createdAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp of when the error type was created. |
| `data.updatedAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp of the last update. |

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Error type created successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 4,
    "name": "critical pro",
    "displayName": "Critical (-25 pts)",
    "points": 30,
    "createdAt": "2026-07-13T04:50:17.079-04:00",
    "updatedAt": "2026-07-13T04:50:17.080-04:00"
  }
}
```

## Show Error Type

Retrieves a specific error type by its unique ID. This endpoint returns detailed information about a single error type, including its name, display name, and associated point deduction value.

---

### Endpoint

```
GET {{url}}/api/error-types/:id
```

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Description                          | Example |
|-----------|---------|----------|--------------------------------------|---------|
| `id`      | integer | ✅ Yes   | The unique identifier of the error type to retrieve. | `1` |

---

### Authentication

This endpoint requires a valid authentication token. The `token` variable must be set in your environment and included in the request (e.g., as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header).

---

### Variables Used

| Variable | Description                                      |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `url`    | The base URL of the API (e.g., `https://api.example.com`) |
| `id`     | The path variable identifying the error type     |
| `token`  | The authentication token for authorized access   |

---

### Response

#### ✅ 200 — Success

Returns the error type object matching the provided ID.

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Error type retrieved successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "minor",
    "displayName": "Minor (-5 pts)",
    "points": 5,
    "createdAt": "2026-04-02T09:51:25.000-04:00",
    "updatedAt": "2026-04-02T09:51:25.000-04:00"
  }
}
```

#### Response Fields

| Field                | Type    | Description                                              |
|----------------------|---------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `status`             | boolean | Indicates whether the request was successful             |
| `message`            | string  | A human-readable message describing the result           |
| `data.id`            | integer | The unique identifier of the error type                  |
| `data.name`          | string  | The internal name/key of the error type                  |
| `data.displayName`   | string  | The human-readable label, including point deduction info |
| `data.points`        | integer | The number of points deducted for this error type        |
| `data.createdAt`     | string  | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the record was created        |
| `data.updatedAt`     | string  | ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update to the record      |

## Listing Error Types

Retrieves a paginated list of error types. Supports filtering and sorting to narrow down results based on various criteria.

---

### Request Body Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number for pagination (starts at 1) |
| `page_size` | integer | Yes | Number of records to return per page |
| `filters` | array | No | Array of filter objects to narrow results |
| `sorts` | array | No | Array of sort objects to order results |

#### Filter Object

Each object in the `filters` array can contain the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `columnName` | string | The field to filter on. Supported values: `manager_id`, `review_id`, `note_id`, `practitioner_id`, `decision`, `ai_status`, `priority`, `human_result`, `created_at`, `search` |
| `type` | string | Filter type (e.g., `exact`) |
| `value` | string | The value to filter by |
| `startDate` | string | Start date for date range filters (used with `created_at`) |
| `endDate` | string | End date for date range filters (used with `created_at`) |

#### Sort Object

Each object in the `sorts` array can contain the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `columnName` | string | The field to sort on |
| `orderBy` | string | Sort direction — `asc` for ascending, `desc` for descending |

---

### Example Request Body

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "page_size": 10,
  "filters": [
    {
      "columnName": "created_at",
      "type": "exact",
      "startDate": "2024-01-01",
      "endDate": "2024-12-31"
    }
  ],
  "sorts": [
    {
      "columnName": "createdAt",
      "orderBy": "desc"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

### Response

Returns a status, message, and a paginated `data` object.

#### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `status` | string/boolean | Indicates success or failure of the request |
| `message` | string | Human-readable response message |
| `data.count` | integer | Number of records returned in the current page |
| `data.total_count` | integer | Total number of error type records matching the query |
| `data.total_page_count` | integer | Total number of pages available |
| `data.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `data.page_size` | integer | Number of records per page |
| `data.data` | array | Array of error type objects |

#### Error Type Object

Each item in `data.data` contains:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer/string | Unique identifier of the error type |
| `name` | string | Internal name of the error type |
| `displayName` | string | Human-readable display name |
| `points` | number | Points associated with the error type |
| `createdAt` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the record was created |
| `updatedAt` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the record was last updated |

## Update Error Type

Updates an existing error type by its unique ID. Use this endpoint to modify the internal name, display name, or point value associated with a specific error type.

---

### Endpoint

`PATCH {{url}}/api/error-types/:id`

---

### Path Variables

| Variable | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | The unique ID of the error type to update. *(Example: `4`)* |

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON object with one or more of the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Internal name of the error type (e.g. `"critical pro maz"`). |
| `display_name` | string | Human-readable display name shown to users, typically including point deduction info (e.g. `"Critical (-25 pts)"`). |
| `points` | integer | Point value associated with the error type (e.g. `30`). |

**Example Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "critical pro maz",
  "display_name": "Critical (-25 pts)",
  "points": 30
}
```

---

### Response

**200 OK** — Returns the updated error type object.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `status` | boolean | Indicates whether the request was successful. |
| `message` | string | A human-readable confirmation message. |
| `data.id` | integer | The unique ID of the error type. |
| `data.name` | string | The updated internal name. |
| `data.displayName` | string | The updated display name. |
| `data.points` | integer | The updated point value. |
| `data.createdAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when the error type was originally created. |
| `data.updatedAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when the error type was last updated. |

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Error type updated successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 4,
    "name": "critical pro maz",
    "displayName": "Critical (-25 pts)",
    "points": 30,
    "createdAt": "2026-07-13T04:50:17.000-04:00",
    "updatedAt": "2026-07-13T04:53:27.244-04:00"

}
```

## Create Feedback

Submits user feedback for a specific description or item within a session. This endpoint allows clients to record a verdict and optional comment associated with a given description, enabling feedback collection and review workflows.

---

## Request Body

The request body should be sent as raw JSON with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session_id` | `string` | The unique identifier of the session in which the feedback is being submitted. |
| `description_id` | `string` | The identifier of the description or item being reviewed (e.g., `"obj_3"`). |
| `verdict` | `integer` | A numeric value representing the user's verdict or rating for the described item. |
| `comment` | `string` | An optional free-text comment providing additional context or explanation for the verdict. |

**Example Request Body:**

``` json
{
  "session_id": "your-session-id",
  "description_id": "obj_3",
  "verdict": 2,
  "comment": "This issue is related to ..."
}
 ```
